thoughts.text: The best interfaces are the ones where you don't notice the interface.
thoughts.textZh: 最好的界面，是让你注意不到界面存在的界面。

thoughts.text: Just realized that 90% of CSS complexity comes from fighting the defaults instead of understanding them.
thoughts.textZh: 刚意识到 90% 的 CSS 复杂性来源于与默认值对抗，而不是理解它们。

thoughts.text: Reading Dieter Rams again. 'Good design is as little design as possible' hits different after shipping 100+ components.
thoughts.textZh: 重读 Dieter Rams。发布 100+ 组件后再看「好的设计是尽可能少的设计」，感受完全不同。

thoughts.text: SlowLog is not empty — it's the space where words settle.
thoughts.textZh: 慢日志不是空白 — 它是让文字沉淀的空间。
